_doc: M4 nests (PLAN M4: 6-10 on the home map, stages 1-5, grow over time and from Noise/Glow, bud at stage 4, destroyed = a core sample). `count` is for a Normal map and scales with map area. Nests are laid from the seed at the start, at least `minHqDist` cells from the HQ and `minGap` from each other, on land in or beside woods when it can. A nest's `fed` (0-1) follows the Noise (and Glow, by the family's weights) arriving at it: every `every` ticks fed = fed x (1 - `feedRate`) + heard x `feedRate`, where heard = field / 255. Growth per tick to the next stage = 1 / growTicks x (1 + `feedGrow` x fed). The raid timer counts down by (`raidBase` + `feedRaid` x fed) a tick: an unfed nest raids rarely, a fed one often. `reach` = how far (cells) its raids look for a target. `raid` = how many of each enemy a raid of this stage sends (scaled by difficulty and by `perDay` a day). `guards` stay round the nest. `budAt`: from this stage on, every `budTicks` it sends out a new stage-1 nest `budDist` cells away (up to `max` nests).
